profile.summary: The lender’s protections assume RumbleOn will generate enough EBITDA to stay under leverage limits, maintain at least $25 M liquidity, meet quarterly amortization, retain access to the delayed‑draw facility, deliver timely financial statements and compliance certificates, preserve sufficient collateral, and realize the expected synergies from the RideNow transaction.

assumptions.title: Sufficient EBITDA to keep leverage ≤4.25
assumptions.claim: The company will generate Consolidated EBITDA high enough to keep its Consolidated Total Net Leverage Ratio at or below 4.25 to 1.00.

evidence.quote: its Consolidated Total Net Leverage Ratio to be greater than 4.25 to 1.00

assumptions.title: Minimum liquidity of $25 M
assumptions.claim: The company will maintain unrestricted cash and cash equivalents of at least $25,000,000 at all times.

evidence.quote: its Liquidity to be less than $25,000,000

assumptions.title: Ability to make quarterly amortization payments
assumptions.claim: The company will have sufficient cash to make the required 0.25% quarterly amortization payments on the Initial Term Loan Facility.

evidence.quote: the Company is required to make amortization payments in an aggregate principal amount equal to 0.25% of the aggregate principal amount of the Initial Term Loan Facility

assumptions.title: Timely financial reporting and compliance certification
assumptions.claim: The company will deliver its financial statements and compliance certificates to the administrative agent within the required periods.

evidence.quote: as soon as available, but in any event within one hundred twenty (120) days after the end of each fiscal year of the Borrower
a duly completed Compliance Certificate signed by a Responsible Officer of the Borrower

assumptions.title: Adequate collateral to support first‑priority lien
assumptions.claim: The company’s assets will remain sufficient to support the first‑priority lien on substantially all of its assets and those of its subsidiary guarantors.

evidence.quote: Obligations under the Credit Agreement are secured by a first-priority lien on substantially all of the assets of the Company and its domestic wholly owned subsidiaries

assumptions.title: RideNow transaction completion and synergies
assumptions.claim: The RideNow transaction will be completed and the expected synergies will contribute to EBITDA, supporting covenant compliance.

evidence.quote: completed its business combination with RideNow Powersports, the nation’s largest powersports retailer group

relationships.rationale: Expected synergies from the RideNow transaction increase Consolidated EBITDA, helping the company stay below the leverage ceiling.
Strong EBITDA improves cash flow, enabling the company to keep unrestricted cash above the liquidity threshold.
EBITDA‑derived cash flow funds the 0.25% quarterly amortization of the Initial Term Loan.
Maintaining a first‑priority lien on assets preserves access to credit, which underpins operations and EBITDA.
Regular financial statements and compliance certificates provide the lender with visibility into EBITDA, allowing early detection of leverage breaches.
